text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school, I spotted Satono Diamond 
running up to Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, please take this! Maybe this 
will help stop your hiccups!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, that's a huge help! I'll gladly accept 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
They just won't stop, will they... And I 
have a speech scheduled at the meeting 
later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Time is slipping away as we speak...! 
Whatever shall I do...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, could you spare me some time 
before the party? There is something I 
would like you to try out!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer! Sorry, but I have a favor 
to ask!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Make an announcement across the academy 
and prohibit anyone from going up to the 
roof right away!
choice_data_list: What are you planning to do?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to explain right now... 
Please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-It is on quite a grand scale, isn't 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I gave in and made the announcement. What 
on earth does she plan to do now...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“......*Hic*. It is almost time for the 
meeting, isn't it......”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please wait just a moment lon— Ah, they're 
here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flip-flip-flip-flip-flip-flip-flip...!)

text_block_list.name: Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
HQ! HQ! We have arrived at Tracen Academy! 
Commencing support for the young lady's 
classmate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-A helicopter...!? Whatever is going 
on... !?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've called in the private medical corps 
retained by the Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whir-whir-whirrrrr...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Right here is a mobile intensive care 
unit, fully equipped with the latest 
medical facilities, including an ICU!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you exaggerating just a bit too 
much?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Come on, step inside! This should stop 
your hiccups!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Th-This is utterly absurd~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oh? Um... So many shocking things 
happened at once that my hiccups seem to 
have stopped.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?! Hiccups, prepare to be 
defeated!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please do not startle me so. Still... 
thank you, Satono-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! If I was able to help even 
a little bit... that makes me happy!
choice_data_list:
You really pushed yourself out there. Good 
work!

You really gave it your all out there. 
Great job!

The scale was beyond anything I 
imagined...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! If I was able to help even 
a little bit... that makes me happy!
choice_data_list:
You really pushed yourself out there. Good 
work!

You really gave it your all out there. 
Great job!

The scale was beyond anything I 
imagined...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it was all for you, McQueen-san♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If anything else comes up, please let me 
know! I'll do everything in my power to 
help you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... When that time comes, please keep 
it within the bounds of common sense...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond, full of enthusiasm, looked 
even more dependable than usual.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, perhaps it would have been better 
to resolve things more peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it...! We should have just 
transported McQueen-san by private jet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...D-Do you really think so...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but be amazed by Satono 
Diamond's wildly out-of-the-box ideas.
